description_fill_in: Unique identifier for the leaf image inspection record in the batch (Format: IMG followed by 5-digit sequence).
Botanical crop host category of the inspected leaf specimen (Valid categories: Apple, Corn, Pepper, Potato, Tomato).
Pathological diagnosis or condition classified on the leaf (Valid classes: Bacterial_Spot, Early_Blight, Late_Blight, Leaf_Scorch, Healthy).
Algorithmic prediction probability score bounded between 0.000 and 1.000 representing diagnosis certainty.
Qualitative assessment of visual infection extent or damage (Categories: None, Mild, Moderate, Severe; 'None' for healthy or uninfected leaves).
Physical surface area of the sampled leaf blade measured in square centimeters (cm^2).
Identifier representing the agricultural field data collection session or batch run (Format: BATCH followed by 3-digit sequence; range BATCH001 to BATCH020).
